displayName: [Preview]: Azure Key Vault Managed HSM extended regions should use allowed locations
description: Audit Azure Key Vault Managed HSM pools when a multi-region replication extended (secondary) region is outside the list of allowed locations. This policy does not evaluate the pool's primary region.

metadata.description: The list of locations where Azure Key Vault Managed HSM extended (secondary) regions are allowed.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy
